description.value:
Traits Signal

Your Broadcast does not end when you fall unconscious. Its Frequency continues to apply, your allies can continue to spend Encore, and you continue to gain 1 Encore at the start of each of your turns even though you cannot act on them. It ends immediately if you die.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB3 — modifies Broadcast's own end-conditions; no item to alter. No "Broadcast" stance/aura item is ever instantiated as an Item with its own system.rules anywhere in this corpus. The shape (a stance whose aura buffs allies) is real and buildable in pf2e via Aura + a companion effect item -- but no such Broadcast item exists among this class's files to attach a rule element to.
